items.question: What is Adrenaline?
items.answer: Adrenaline is a youth trips & experiences brand for university and high school students in Egypt. We run Tal3a Packages, Rehla Packages, and Pump ur Adrenaline experiences, plus Fundays, senior trips, private trips, and fully custom itineraries.

items.question: Who is Adrenaline for?
items.answer: 16–25-year-olds who love adventure, community, and experiences — mainly university and high school students looking for trips that don't feel like the same routine.

items.question: Do I need to create an account?
items.answer: Yes, you need to create an account to book trips. Registration is free and allows you to manage your bookings, save preferences, and receive personalized recommendations.

items.question: Is the website free to use?
items.answer: Yes, browsing and searching for trips is completely free. You only pay when you book a trip.

items.question: What makes Adrenaline different?
items.answer: Trips with a pulse, not a checklist. Real people, original trip ideas, and a community of students who actually go together — not a generic tour package.

items.question: How do I book a trip?
items.answer: Open Upcoming Trips, pick a dated departure, choose how many travellers, then fill in each traveller's details (ID/passport photo, emergency contact) and your payment choice. Once you send the deposit, your seat is confirmed.

items.question: How does payment work?
items.answer: A 50% deposit reserves your seat. You pay by InstaPay or Vodafone Cash and choose whether to pay the deposit or the full amount now. The remaining balance must be paid in full before the trip. Missing that date can forfeit your seat and deposit. Bookings also close on the trip's deadline, or earlier if it reaches full capacity.

items.question: Will I receive a booking confirmation?
items.answer: Yes, you will receive an instant confirmation on screen and the booking will appear in your 'My Bookings' page. You'll also receive a booking ID for reference.

items.question: Can I book for someone else?
items.answer: Yes, you can book trips for friends and family. Just provide their details during the booking process or add them as accompanying travelers.

items.question: What types of trips do you offer?
items.answer: Tal3a Packages (day outings), Rehla Packages (multi-day trips), Pump ur Adrenaline (single adrenaline activities), and fully Custom Trips. We also handle Fundays, senior trips, private trips, hotel booking, transportation, tour guides, and an electronic photo book after the trip.

items.question: Can I customize my trip?
items.answer: Absolutely! Use our Custom Trip Builder to create your perfect itinerary. You can choose destinations, duration, accommodation, transportation, and add special requests.

items.question: Are meals included in the packages?
items.answer: Some packages include meals, others offer it as an optional add-on. Check each package's details to see what's included and what can be added.

items.question: Can I request a specific tour guide?
items.answer: Yes, you can request specific guides during booking. We'll do our best to accommodate your request based on availability.

items.question: How do I create an account?
items.answer: Click 'Sign Up' on the homepage, fill in your name, email, password, and other details. It takes less than 2 minutes!

items.question: How do I reset my password?
items.answer: Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page and follow the instructions. You'll receive an email with a reset link.

items.question: Can I close my account?
items.answer: Yes. Go to Profile and use Close My Account. You'll be signed out and won't be able to log back in, but your bookings and history stay on file. Contact support if you ever want it reopened.

items.question: What is your cancellation and refund policy?
items.answer: Refunds depend on how much notice you give: more than 6 days before departure = 80% refund of the total trip cost; 3 to 5 days before departure = 60% refund; less than 42 hours before departure or a no-show = no refund. Cancellation terms also apply to your deposit.

items.question: Can I give my spot to someone else?
items.answer: Yes. You can transfer your booking to another person at any time for a 100% refund. You're responsible for finding the replacement, and your refund is processed as soon as their registration is confirmed and their full payment is received. Let us know about the name change at least 48 hours before departure.

items.question: How do I cancel a booking?
items.answer: Go to 'My Bookings', find your booking, and click 'Cancel'. Follow the confirmation steps and your refund (if any) is calculated from the notice period above.

items.question: What if the trip is cancelled by us?
items.answer: If we have to cancel a trip, you receive a full refund and we'll help you find another departure.

items.question: How do I contact customer support?
items.answer: Use the Contact page, or reach us through our Linktree at linktr.ee/Adrenaline98 for all our social channels.

items.question: What are your support hours?
items.answer: Message us through the Contact page or our Linktree and we'll get back to you as soon as we can.

items.question: Who do I contact for emergencies during a trip?
items.answer: Your tour guide is your first point of contact on any live trip. For anything else, reach the team through the Contact page.
